productName: Lorena Canals Woolable Africa Enkang Washable Area Rug
description: With the Africa collection, Lorena Canals pays homage to the Maasai people with a series of beautifully crafted wool rugs that draw inspiration from the culture and artistic legacy of the region. The handsome Enkang Ivory area rug is named for the acacia fencing used to protect Maasai villages, its patterns mimicking tangled branches. Africa collection area rugs are some of the very few machine-washable wool rugs on the market today.
